WelcomeEmailSubject: Welcome to EnviroEyes™ by Zealandia Consulting!
WelcomeEmailBody:
Welcome to EnviroEyes™ by Zealandia Consulting!

To activate your account and start exploring EnviroEyes™, please click on "Reset password." right below the Log in button after clicking here: Confirm My Account

Once your account is confirmed, you'll gain access to your organisation's EnviroEyes™ deployments. If you have any questions, our team is here to assist.

Then follow instructions in the email you'll receive to set a password for your account.

Thank you for joining us in advancing environmental monitoring with EnviroEyes™!

Best regards,
The EnviroEyes™ Team
Zealandia Consulting Ltd
